insomnia.definition: Difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep or waking too early, together with daytime impairment. The daytime effect is part of the definition.
insomnia.example: It is not just that I sleep badly; it is that I cannot work properly the next day. That makes it insomnia.

nest.definition: The little home a bird builds out of twigs and grass. It is warm and it holds the eggs.
nest.example: Wren's nest was in the apple tree.

si_second.definition: The unit of time equal to one sixtieth of a minute.

taste_buds.definition: The tiny bumps on your tongue that pick out sweet, salty, sour and bitter.
taste_buds.example: Taste buds tell you that the mango is sweet.
